tasks.title: Scaffold repo
tasks.prompt: Create a Next.js 15 App Router project with TypeScript strict, Tailwind and shadcn/ui, using pnpm. Add Vitest. Add the folder layout from AGENT.md as empty placeholders. Copy .env.example and .gitignore from the kit. Do not add any other dependency.
tasks.acceptance: pnpm dev serves a blank page; pnpm test runs with zero tests; .env is ignored by git.

tasks.title: Env validation
tasks.prompt: Add src/lib/env.ts that parses process.env with Zod and throws a clear error naming any missing variable. Use the variables listed in .env.example. Never log values.
tasks.acceptance: Starting the app with a missing PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID fails with a message naming it.

tasks.title: PayPal spike script
tasks.prompt: Write scripts/spike.ts. Steps: get an OAuth token; create an order (intent CAPTURE, one item, USD); print the approve link and wait for me to approve as the sandbox buyer, then press Enter; capture the order; issue a partial refund of 1.00 USD with a fixed PayPal-Request-Id; repeat the same refund call and print that PayPal returned the same refund without a second one. Print every response status and id. Use fetch only. Mark anything unproven as [VERIFY IN SANDBOX].
tasks.acceptance: I run pnpm spike with US sandbox accounts and see capture id, refund id, and an identical refund on replay.

tasks.title: Webhook receiver and signature check
tasks.prompt: Create src/app/api/webhooks/paypal/route.ts on the Node runtime. Read the raw body with request.text(). Verify using POST /v1/notifications/verify-webhook-signature with PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-ID, PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-TIME, PAYPAL-CERT-URL, PAYPAL-AUTH-ALGO, PAYPAL-TRANSMISSION-SIG, PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID and the parsed raw body. Reject with 400 if verification is not SUCCESS. Log event id and type only. Do not touch the DB yet.
tasks.acceptance: A real PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED event from the spike appears in logs with verification SUCCESS. Simulator events are rejected.

tasks.title: Deploy to Render
tasks.prompt: Add a render.yaml and a README section for deploying the Next.js app as a Render web service with env vars set in the dashboard. Do not commit secrets.
tasks.acceptance: Public Render URL receives the real webhook from the sandbox app.

tasks.title: Prisma schema
tasks.prompt: Create prisma/schema.prisma for the models in PRD section 6 on Neon Postgres. Add UNIQUE constraints on WebhookEvent.eventId and Refund.idempotencyKey. Add the first migration.
tasks.acceptance: prisma migrate dev succeeds; inserting a duplicate eventId fails.

tasks.title: Typed PayPal client
tasks.prompt: Create src/lib/paypal/client.ts, orders.ts, refunds.ts with typed fetch wrappers and Zod-parsed responses. Cache the OAuth token until shortly before expiry. Every mutating call takes an idempotency key and sends it as PayPal-Request-Id. Map PayPal errors to a typed error with name, debug_id and status. Support an optional PayPal-Mock-Response header for negative tests.
tasks.acceptance: Unit tests with a mocked fetch cover success, 422 REFUND_AMOUNT_EXCEEDED style errors, and token refresh.

tasks.title: Webhook persistence and dedupe
tasks.prompt: After signature verification, insert the event into WebhookEvent. On unique violation, return 200 and do nothing else. On PAYMENT.CAPTURE.REFUNDED, update the matching Refund row to confirmed. Also add a GET-poll helper that reads the refund state from PayPal so the UI never depends on webhook timing.
tasks.acceptance: Posting the same real event twice results in one row and one state transition.

tasks.title: Offer engine
tasks.prompt: Implement src/lib/engine/offer.ts exactly as PRD section 5: guards, AUTO_OFFER / MANUAL_REVIEW / FULL_RETURN_ONLY decision, and the offer amount in integer cents. Pure function, no I/O. Write Vitest tests including property-style tests proving offerCents never exceeds capCents or remainingRefundableCents for random inputs, and that any failed guard never yields AUTO_OFFER.
tasks.acceptance: All tests pass. A test named 'vision cannot change the amount' passes.

tasks.title: Nonce service
tasks.prompt: Implement src/lib/engine/nonce.ts: generate a 6 digit single-use nonce per case, 10 minute expiry, bound to the case id, marked used on consumption. Tests for expiry, reuse and wrong-case use.
tasks.acceptance: Expired, reused and cross-case nonces are rejected.

tasks.title: Refund executor
tasks.prompt: Implement the function that, given an approved case, computes the idempotency key (UUIDv5 from caseId + action + revision), re-checks remaining refundable from PayPal, clamps to engine rules, calls the partial refund, and stores the Refund row before and after the call. A retry after a timeout must return the same refund.
tasks.acceptance: Test with a mocked PayPal that drops the first response: second attempt yields exactly one refund.

tasks.title: Vision schema and guards
tasks.prompt: Create src/lib/vision/schema.ts with the strict Zod schema from PRD section 7 (reject extra fields) and guards.ts that strips imperative text from notes and enforces length. Notes are display-only and never parsed into logic.
tasks.acceptance: Output containing an amount field or extra keys is rejected.

tasks.title: Gemini call with cache and caps
tasks.prompt: Create src/lib/vision/gemini.ts calling the model in GEMINI_MODEL with structured JSON output and a system prompt that treats image text as untrusted. Add SHA-256 caching in VisionCache and per-IP hourly and global daily caps from src/lib/limits.ts. When capped or on any error, return a result that forces MANUAL_REVIEW.
tasks.acceptance: Same image twice causes one model call. Hitting the cap causes MANUAL_REVIEW, never an offer.

tasks.title: Adversarial eval harness
tasks.prompt: Create eval/expected.json and a pnpm eval:vision script that runs every image in eval/ through the pipeline plus the offer engine and prints a pass/fail table. Required cases: stock photo, photo of a screen, wrong item, ambiguous scratch, missing nonce, injected text, blurry image, major damage, and 2 clean minor-scratch cases. I will supply the images. [NEEDS INPUT: eval images]
tasks.acceptance: Zero AUTO_OFFER on any case other than the clean minor-scratch ones.

tasks.title: Case creation and nonce screen
tasks.prompt: Build the buyer page for creating a case from a captured order and showing the nonce with a countdown. Plain, mobile-first shadcn UI. Copy must follow the claims guardrails in RULES.md.
tasks.acceptance: Screenshot on a 390px wide viewport shows nonce and timer.

tasks.title: Photo upload and offer screen
tasks.prompt: Add photo upload (client resize to max 1600px), call the evidence endpoint, then show one of: capped keep-it offer with accept/decline, 'sent for merchant review', or 'return required'. Accept triggers the refund executor and then polls PayPal until the refund is confirmed.
tasks.acceptance: End to end in the browser: offer accepted, real sandbox partial refund visible.

tasks.title: Policy form
tasks.prompt: Build the merchant policy page for the fields in MerchantPolicy with validation (cents, percent bounds, minConfidence 0..1). Show a live preview of the offer for a sample order using the real engine function.
tasks.acceptance: Changing the cap changes the previewed offer and never exceeds the cap.

tasks.title: Review queue and ledger
tasks.prompt: Build the manual review queue (approve, edit down within cap, reject) and a ledger table showing case, decision, offer, refund id, webhook verified badge and event id. Plain shadcn table.
tasks.acceptance: Approving a queued case issues one refund and the ledger shows the verified webhook.

tasks.title: OPTIONAL: full-return branch with Add Tracking
tasks.prompt: Only if ahead of schedule. For FULL_RETURN_ONLY cases, accept a carrier and tracking number, call POST /v2/checkout/orders/{id}/track on the captured order, and hold the full refund until the merchant marks it received. Never attach tracking on the keep-it path. [VERIFY IN SANDBOX: tracking only works on captured orders]
tasks.acceptance: Tracker created on a captured order; refund released only after merchant confirms.

tasks.title: Signed-cookie workspaces and reset
tasks.prompt: Create per-visitor workspaces from a signed cookie using SESSION_SECRET, seeded with sample policy and orders from the pre-captured pool, auto-reset after 60 minutes, plus a Reset button. Add a per-workspace refund cap.
tasks.acceptance: Two browsers see isolated data. Reset restores seed data.

tasks.title: Judge help bar and negative-test drawer
tasks.prompt: Add a top bar showing the sandbox buyer email and password and a one-line how-to. Add a drawer that toggles PayPal-Mock-Response for the next refund so judges can see failures handled without corrupting the ledger.
tasks.acceptance: Injected failure leaves the case in a retryable state with no phantom refund.

tasks.title: Cold-tester run
tasks.prompt: Write TESTING.md describing a 90 second path for a stranger to complete the flow on the hosted URL. I will run it with someone who has never seen the app.
tasks.acceptance: A cold tester finishes in under 90 seconds without help.

tasks.title: README and license
tasks.prompt: Write README.md: one-line pitch, claims-guardrails wording, architecture diagram (Mermaid), PayPal endpoints used, AI tools and models used, run instructions, env table, honest limitations. Add the MIT LICENSE file. ASCII only. [NEEDS INPUT: license confirmation]
tasks.acceptance: Fresh clone runs from the README alone.

tasks.title: Video script and checklist
tasks.prompt: Turn PRD section 12 into a timed shooting script with exact on-screen actions. Add a submission checklist: public repo with license visible in About, hosted demo URL tested incognito on mobile and desktop, YouTube video under 3:00, Devpost text, AI tools listed.
tasks.acceptance: Dry run of the script lands under 2:55.
